claim: The primary landing page for the Creators 4 Mental Health / Lupiani Insights & Strategies study discloses no sample size, methodology, field dates, or country breakdown - all the load-bearing figures (n=542, North America, 62% burnout, 89% lack access, 10% suicidal ideation) are recoverable only from secondary journalism (Tubefilter), not from the study's own primary page.
stance_target: methodological transparency of the Creators 4 Mental Health study at its own source
scope_conditions: Provenance/methodology-audit finding. This is the study's official landing page (creators4mentalhealth.com/study) fetched directly; it renders as a near-empty JavaScript shell (98 words) with sponsor logos and one pull-quote, but no data tables, PDF, or methodology statement are present in the fetched HTML. Confirms the partnership with Lupiani Insights & Strategies named in the secondary coverage.
quoted_support: "Landmark Creator Mental Health Study Reveals Rising Burnout and Anxiety Across the Industry... The first comprehensive study on content creator mental health...conducted in partnership with Lupiani Insights & Strategies"
region: unstated on this page (North America per secondary coverage)
